effect:
Cures all status problems. (Hold)

Heals any status - poison, burn, paralysis, freeze, sleep. One-time use but covers everything.

I put this on setup sweepers a lot since getting burned or paralyzed mid-sweep is basically game over. Also good on stuff that's gonna eat a Thunder Wave or Will-O-Wisp coming in. If you don't know what berry to use, Lum is almost never wrong.
